title: Kinetic Energy
description: Calculate translational and rotational kinetic energy. Translational kinetic energy is the energy of motion from one location to another, calculated as Et = 1/2 m v². Rotational kinetic energy is the energy due to rotational motion, calculated as Er = 1/2 I ω².

components.content:
# Kinetic Energy Calculator

Calculate translational and rotational kinetic energy using the formulas:

**Translational Kinetic Energy:** Et = 1/2 m v²
- m = mass (kg)
- v = velocity (m/s)

**Rotational Kinetic Energy:** Er = 1/2 I ω²
- I = moment of inertia (kg m²)
- ω = angular velocity (rad/s)

outputs.label: Total Kinetic Energy
outputs.formula: (0.5 * inputs.mass * inputs.velocity * inputs.velocity) + (0.5 * inputs.moment_of_inertia * inputs.angular_velocity * inputs.angular_velocity)
